title: 第007章 实力暴涨九叔的下巴都快惊掉了第008章 茅山祖师看了都流泪九叔直呼开挂
slug: 九叔饲养百倍返还僵尸成旱魃
content_zh:
等到第二天天蒙蒙亮，当大公鸡扯着脖子打鸣时，苏辰才缓缓睁开眼。
一夜未睡，他眼底却没有半点疲色。
相反，整个人精神得厉害。
他提起桃木剑，径直去了后院。
此时晨雾还没散，老槐树的影子斜斜压在青石板上，地面还带着昨夜露水的潮气。
苏辰站在空地中央，手腕一翻，先吞下了一枚【凡阶上品精血丹】。
丹药一入腹，犹如吞下了一团烈火，胸腔内气血如龙般翻滚起来。
他没有立刻出剑，而是单手持剑，站在原地，微闭双眼，静默了两息。
下一刻——
砰！
脚下青石板发出一声闷响，苏辰身形如猎豹般悍然前冲！
铮！
桃木剑刷地一声破风而出，那原本钝木的剑锋，竟在晨雾里生生划出了一道犹如实质的冷冽寒光！
斜撩、横扫、前刺、回身反斩！
动作大开大合，一气呵成，带起的凌厉剑风将地上沾染着露水的碎叶瞬间卷起。
他练的，正是九叔亲传的【斩邪剑法】。
这套剑法本就是茅山一脉为了下山除魔卫道而创的杀伐路数，不求花哨，只讲究干脆、利落、狠毒，出剑必指要害，讲究一击必杀见结果！
而此时，昨夜脑海中领悟的那份关于“斩邪符”的极品感悟，竟在不知不觉中与剑法一并涌上了心头！
符，是笔走灵意，沟通天地。
剑，又何尝不是？！

一笔一划能斩邪，一招一式，同样能破万法！
苏辰越练越快，手中的桃木剑越发顺畅。
起剑时，那股独属于极品斩邪符的凝练符意，竟像是化作了剑气，顺着木剑的锋芒流转吞吐！
转身、腾挪间，【冥行观想法】带来的那份对肌肉和灵力的绝对掌控力，让他的腰胯、肩背、手腕连成了一张完美的大弓。
出剑更稳如泰山，收剑则快若奔雷！
呜——呜——！
原本普通的后院里，竟响起了剑风撕裂空气的厉啸。
被卷起的落叶还未落地，便被无形的剑气绞成了细碎的粉末!
院里的树叶、小花、爬山虎、地上的草屑，全都被这套凌厉无匹的剑法气场牵引着震动起来。
苏辰一剑快过一剑，额头隐隐见汗，但眼神却越来越亮如星辰。
精血丹那庞大的药力在体内疯狂翻滚，硬生生被这一套霸道的剑法逼开，完美地融进每一寸筋骨血肉之中，连带着双臂上的千钧之力都在一寸寸地往上涨！
也就在这时，义庄那破旧的院门外，忽然传来一阵沉稳有力的脚步声。
是九叔回来了。
他风尘仆仆，肩上还沾着点路上的灰，手里提着个包袱，刚跨进后院，抬眼便看见苏辰一跃而起，凌空一剑斩出！
嗤——！
剑锋自上而下劈落，带出一道极其干净利落、没有丝毫拖泥带水的轨迹。
半空中，一片刚刚从老槐树上飘落的枯黄树叶首当其冲，被那无形的剑气扫过，竟悄无声息地应声裂成两半！
切口之处平滑如镜，飘飘晃晃地落向地面。
content_en:
It was not until dawn the next day, when the big rooster stretched his neck and crowed, that Su Chen slowly opened his eyes.
He hadn't slept all night, but his eyes didn't look tired at all.
On the contrary, the whole person was very energetic.
He picked up the mahogany sword and went straight to the backyard.
At this time, the morning fog has not yet dispersed, and the shadow of the old locust tree slants on the bluestone, and the ground is still moist from last night's dew.
Su Chen stood in the middle of the open space, flipped his wrist, and swallowed a [Mortal Grade High-Grade Blood Essence Pill] first.
As soon as the elixir entered his abdomen, it was as if he had swallowed a ball of fire, and the energy and blood in his chest started rolling like a dragon.
He did not draw the sword immediately, but held the sword in one hand, stood there, closed his eyes slightly, and took two breaths of silence.
The next moment——
Bang!
The bluestone beneath his feet made a muffled sound, and Su Chen charged forward like a cheetah!
Zheng!
The Taomu Sword broke through the wind with a swipe, and the originally dull wooden blade actually cut a cold light that seemed to be real in the morning mist!
Tilt, sweep, thrust forward, turn around and slash back!
The movements were wide open and closed in one go, and the sharp sword wind brought up instantly rolled up the dew-stained broken leaves on the ground.
What he practiced was the [Evil-Slaying Sword Technique] taught by Uncle Nine.
This set of swordsmanship is originally a method of killing created by the Maoshan lineage in order to go down the mountain to eliminate demons and defend the road. It does not seek to be fancy, but only emphasizes on being crisp, sharp, and vicious. The sword must point to the vital point, and it emphasizes that one blow will kill and the result will be seen!
At this time, the ultimate insight about the "evil-killing talisman" that I had comprehended in my mind last night unexpectedly came to my mind along with the swordsmanship without even realizing it!
Talisman is a pen that conveys spiritual meaning and communicates between heaven and earth.
Sword, so why not? !
One stroke can kill evil, one move can break all kinds of magic!
Su Chen practiced faster and faster, and the peach wood sword in his hand became smoother.
When the sword was raised, the condensed talismanic spirit that belonged to the best evil-killing talisman actually seemed to have turned into sword energy, flowing along the edge of the wooden sword!
As he turned around and moved around, the absolute control over his muscles and spiritual power brought about by [Method of Meditation on the Underworld] made his waist, hips, shoulders, and wrists connect into a perfect big bow.
When the sword is drawn out, it is as stable as Mount Tai, and when the sword is withdrawn, it is as fast as thunder!
Woo-woo-!
In the originally ordinary backyard, there was a sharp roar of sword wind tearing the air.
The rolled up fallen leaves were crushed into fine powder by the invisible sword energy before they even hit the ground!
The leaves, flowers, ivy, and grass clippings on the ground in the courtyard were all pulled and vibrated by the aura of this powerful swordsmanship.
Su Chen's sword strike was faster than the strike, and there was a hint of sweat on his forehead, but his eyes were getting brighter and brighter than the stars.
The huge medicinal power of the Essence and Blood Pill was rolling wildly in the body, and was forced away by this set of domineering swordsmanship. It was perfectly integrated into every inch of muscle, bone, flesh and blood, and even the tremendous power on both arms was rising inch by inch!
At this moment, there was a sudden sound of steady and powerful footsteps outside the dilapidated courtyard gate of Yizhuang.
It's Uncle Jiu who's back.
He was dusty, his shoulders were still stained with dust from the road, and he was holding a baggage in his hand. As soon as he stepped into the backyard, he looked up and saw Su Chen leaping up and slashing out with a sword in the air!
laugh--!
The blade of the sword slashed down from top to bottom, leaving an extremely clean and neat trajectory without any sloppiness.
In mid-air, a withered yellow leaf that had just fallen from the old locust tree bore the brunt of the impact. It was swept by the invisible sword energy and silently split into two halves!
The incision was as smooth as a mirror, and it fell to the ground flutteringly.
